opennyai_summary.facts:
Pursuant to the settlement, Petitioner No. 1 and Respondent No.2 have obtained a decree of divorce by mutual consent.
Respondent No. 2, who is present before this Court in person and is duly identified by the Investigating Officer, confirms the settlement and gives no objection to the quashing of the impugned FIR.
She further confirms that in terms of the settlement, she has received the entire settlement amount.
